description_en: Queries a list of domain groups
description_zh: 调用QueryDomainGroupList查询域名分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun domain query-domain-group-list --lang en --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --domain-group-name '默认分组' --show-deleting-group false --order-key-type example-string --order-by-type example-string --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDomainGroupList

parameters.help_en:
The language of error messages in the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The client IP address. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义的域名分组名称
parameters.name: domain_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to show domain groups that are being deleted. Valid values:

false

true

The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示正在删除中的域名分组，取值如下：

false：否。
true：是。

默认为false
parameters.name: show_deleting_group

BeingDeleted.description_en: Indicates whether the domain group is being deleted. Deleting a domain group that contains more than 1,000 domains is an asynchronous operation. During this process, the value of this parameter is true
BeingDeleted.description_zh: 是否正在删除中。超过1000个域名的分组删除为异步过程，需要系统处理一段时间，在此期间内该字段为true

CreationDate.description_en: The time the domain group was created

DomainGroupStatus.description_en:
The domain group status. Valid values:

PROCESSING: In progress.

COMPLETE: Complete.

Operations such as setting a domain group from a file or replacing a domain group that contains more than 1,000 domains are asynchronous. While the system is processing the request, the status of the domain group is PROCESSING
DomainGroupStatus.description_zh:
域名分组状态。取值：
PROCESSING：处理中；
COMPLETE：已完成。

通过文件设置分组、替换超过1000个域名的分组等情况下为异步过程，需要等待系统处理，此状态下该字段为PROCESSING

ModificationDate.description_en: The time the domain group was last modified

TotalNumber.description_en: The number of domains in the domain group
